meta.title: Northfield Climate capability map
meta.scope: Combined current-state map of Northfield Climate and the acquired Pine Ridge Service, to choose the first two transformation releases.
meta.basis_note: Synthetic example. Scores come from a fictional lifecycle workshop and interviews; two capabilities are scored as hypotheses until their owners confirm them.

goals.statement: Grow residential equipment sales in two new regions
goals.measure: Residential bookings in the new regions

goals.statement: Fix more service calls on the first visit
Serve every customer from one shared customer record
goals.measure: Share of customers with one record across both companies

goals.statement: Lower fleet emissions per service visit

capabilities.name: Audience segmentation and activation
capabilities.definition: Group prospects and customers by need and reach each group with a relevant message.
capabilities.score_reason: Campaigns go to the whole list; dealer and homeowner segments live in separate spreadsheets.
capabilities.impact_reason: The new-region growth goal depends on reaching homeowners through local dealers with tailored offers.

capabilities.name: Territory management
capabilities.definition: Assign accounts and leads to sellers and dealers without overlap.
capabilities.score_reason: Both companies' sellers call the same homeowners; territories are agreed by email.
capabilities.impact_reason: Expanding into two regions adds sellers who will collide without clear territories.

capabilities.name: Quote and proposal management
capabilities.definition: Prepare, approve and send priced equipment and installation proposals.
capabilities.score_reason: A standard template exists; installation labor is priced by hand from a spreadsheet.
capabilities.impact_reason: Faster quotes help new-region sellers, but the current process already works.

capabilities.name: Order entry
capabilities.definition: Pine Ridge's separate order entry, duplicated by Northfield order management after the acquisition.
capabilities.score_reason: Works for Pine Ridge jobs only; orders are rekeyed into Northfield's system for billing.
capabilities.impact_reason: Kept only until Northfield order management covers installation jobs.

capabilities.name: Order management
capabilities.definition: Capture equipment and installation orders and release them to fulfillment and billing.
capabilities.score_reason: Equipment orders flow to the ERP; installation jobs from Pine Ridge are not yet supported.
capabilities.impact_reason: One order record is required before the duplicated order entry can be retired.

capabilities.name: Field service management
capabilities.definition: Plan, dispatch and complete installation and repair visits.

capabilities.name: Scheduling and dispatch
capabilities.definition: Match visits to technicians by skill, location and parts availability.
capabilities.score_reason: Dispatchers assign by memory; parts availability is not visible when a visit is booked.
capabilities.impact_reason: Booking the right technician with the right part is the main lever on first-time fix.

capabilities.name: Work order execution
capabilities.definition: Record work done, parts used and customer sign-off at the visit.
capabilities.score_reason: Technicians fill paper sheets that are typed in days later.
capabilities.impact_reason: Accurate visit records feed parts replenishment and warranty claims.

capabilities.name: Service parts inventory management
capabilities.definition: Know which spare parts are where, reserve them for visits and replenish them.
capabilities.score_reason: Parts sit in three warehouses and four trucks with no shared count, so technicians reorder parts the company already owns.
capabilities.impact_reason: Service leads estimate repeated part purchases as the largest avoidable service cost.

capabilities.name: Customer self-service
capabilities.definition: Let homeowners book visits, see visit status and find answers without calling.
capabilities.score_reason: No portal exists; every request is a phone call.
capabilities.impact_reason: Reduces call volume and lets homeowners send photos before the visit.

priority_override.reason: The sponsor deferred self-service until dispatch and parts are fixed

capabilities.name: Customer feedback and advocacy
capabilities.definition: Ask satisfied customers for reviews and referrals and act on complaints.
capabilities.score_reason: Pine Ridge sends a review request after every visit and responds to complaints within a day.
capabilities.impact_reason: Works well today; no goal depends on improving it.

capabilities.name: Customer profile management
capabilities.definition: Keep one record of each customer, their sites and installed equipment across both companies.
capabilities.score_reason: Each company has its own customer list; about a third of customers appear in both.

capabilities.name: Renewal and service plan sales
capabilities.definition: Sell and renew maintenance plans for installed equipment.
capabilities.score_reason: Renewals are tracked by one coordinator in a calendar.
capabilities.impact_reason: Service plan revenue helps fund the expansion, but renewal volume is small today.

capabilities.name: Billing and collections
capabilities.definition: Invoice equipment, installation and service and collect payment.
capabilities.score_reason: Both companies invoice reliably in their own systems; the merger adds a monthly reconciliation.
capabilities.impact_reason: Needed for one customer record, but not a constraint on the first releases.
